caption: Sh. 4. Stela (Areika, Pl. 33, No. 5103)
reading: wosi soreyi yiwl?e teylo(2)w?i arokye tedḫelowi si(3)rem?roke krorolowi sm?(4)t? krorolowi q?bḫe kroro(5)lowi wel?km? krorolowi a(6)pote m?y?ritowi atmẖ?e p(7)siḫrkete atomẖ?epsi(8)ẖekese?[.][.] [.][.]ḫ?mlol? pso?lkete
notes: No word dividers in this copy; spaces are gaps. Copy rows do not match stone lines (line numbers fall mid-row). 'yiwl?e': the two S-shaped signs are near equal in size, e/l order uncertain. 'te' in teylowi: /ϟ with bar, could be o+l. si(3)rem?roke, sm?(4)t?: the 7-shaped sign (ℸ) read m, could be t (no dot visible); the sign under (4) has a dot before it, read t. q?bḫe: /3 could be s+o (sobḫe). m?y?ritowi: ℸ then two strokes (y?), to = ب with dot below. ẖ in mẖe/psiẖe: plain 3, s or ẖ by shape. Line 8 ends in about 3 sign widths of hatching: two strokes just before it read as the // of se (its v lost), then [.][.]. Last row: hatching then a hatched sign (ḫ? by parallel with Sh. 5 and Sh. 7, could be to), [.][.] for the hatching. pso?lkete: /3 could be q (pqlkete). 'p' here is the long-tailed ξ with curled top; 'k' the flat-topped ʒ with long tail.

caption: Sh. 5. Stela (Areika, Pl. 33, No. 5104)
reading: wosi soreyi : q?om?sḫ(2)rq?owi : sq?oñye ted(3)ḫeli tedḫelowi m?sm?s(4)ls?li terikelowi ssi(5)m?ete m?sḫwi : mlos?r(6)se teñte?lowi atomẖ?e p(7)s?iẖekese atmẖ?e psi(8)ḫrkese l? ḫmlol pso?lke(9)se
notes: //3 read q+o throughout (the same shape is s+o in soreyi; could also be s+y). m and s (ℸ against 3) unsettled in m?sm?s(4)ls?li and m?sḫwi; the bold 3 in that name looks retouched. ted(3)ḫeli: the last two signs are 4 and a small ϟ (li), not lowi. teñte?lowi: middle /ϟ could be o+l (teñlolowi). Sign after the p in line 7 is hatched (s?). Final l? is a small hatched sign standing alone at the end of the row.

caption: Sh. 6. Stela (Areika, Pl. 34, No. 5105)
labels: sic, over the signs 43 at the end of the name, by line 2
blank, by line 6 (a blank space after the first sign of line 6)
reading: wosi : soreyi : q?o : q?o re(2)q?oyl?q?osi : l?edo : teb?d?e(3)i?m?ye : terikelowi : nwi(4)ye : tedḫelowi : apote : (5)y?i[.]rbos?e : yetmdel?owi : (6)m? te?ol? : l?nbelile : se m?lowi : (7)at : mẖ?e : ps[.]ẖ?[.]kete : a(8)t?mẖ?e : psiḫrke?te : ḫml[.](9)l : so?lkete : s?lom?rse : (10)teñ?te?lo wi
notes: Griffith draws three holes in the stone (outlined, not hatched): between e and y of soreyi (line 1), before 'ye' after (4) (line 4), and before te after (10) (line 10); I wrote no [.] for them because the outlines may only mark where the text skirts the hole; signs may be lost there. Line 2 'sic' marks 43 (si) where wi is expected. teb?d?e(3)i?m?ye: second and third signs are a hooked v (b or d) and a P-like sign read d as in yetmde; the sign under (3) is hatched, 4-like (i?). (5) stands over the second of two strokes after 4; y?i is uncertain (could be o o i). (6)m?: a lone ℸ, then the blank, then te o and a hatched sign. Line 7 formula: three hatched signs after ps (i?, a 3-shaped one read ẖ?, r?). In line 9 the hatched sign between l and l is likely o (mlol in Sh. 5 and Sh. 7). teñ?te?lo: the crossed sign could be d; second te is hatched at its slash.

caption: Sh. 7. Stela (Areika, Pl. 34, No. 5106)
reading: wosi soreyi : b?sys?q?o(2)wi : k?sidye : ted(3)ḫelowi : sbre(4)ye : terikelo(5)wi : atomẖ?e : psi[.](6)ẖekete : atmẖ?e : (7)psiḫrkete : ḫ(8)m?lol : pso?lke(9)te si wi : te?kse(10)d? : si wi wi l? : psi(11)ẖes?ke?te
notes: b? in the name: a small v with long tail (b or ḫ). k?sidye: first sign 3 with long underline (k or ẖ). psi[.](6)ẖekete: small hatched mark between i and ẖ. Last row: 'si wi' pairs are 43 (si) and 4 with closed loop (wi), read as written; te?kse(10)d?: /ϟ could be o+l, the sign under (10) is a cross with a dot (d, or t), the divider before it has a third dot. psi(11)ẖes?ke?te: two underlined 3-shapes (s? and k), and a hatched sign before te (e?).
